question: How can I track my order?
variants: is my order on its way
answer: Log in to your account, open 'My Orders', and click 'Track'. You will also get a tracking link by email once your order ships.

question: How long does delivery take?
answer: Standard delivery takes 3-5 business days. Express delivery takes 1-2 business days.

question: How much does shipping cost?
variants: what is the cost of express delivery
answer: Shipping is free on orders over 1200 Taka. Otherwise it costs 40 Taka for standard and 90 Taka for express.

question: Do you ship internationally?
variants: do you deliver to other countries
do you ship to the USA or UK
answer: Yes, we ship to over 40 countries. International delivery takes 7-14 business days.

question: What is your return policy?
variants: can I send an item back
can I return something I bought
answer: You can return any unused item within 30 days of delivery for a full refund.

question: How do I return a product?
variants: how to send back an item
I want to return my purchase
I want to send back a shirt
answer: Go to 'My Orders', choose the item, click 'Return', and print the prepaid label. Drop the parcel at any post office.

question: How long does a refund take?
variants: when will I get my money back
how long until I am refunded
answer: Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days after we receive your returned item.

question: What payment methods do you accept?
variants: can I pay by debit card
answer: We accept Visa, Mastercard, PayPal, and cash on delivery in selected areas.

question: Is it safe to pay on your website?
variants: is my credit card safe here
is it safe to use my card
answer: Yes. All payments are encrypted, and we never store your card details.

question: How do I create an account?
answer: Click 'Sign Up' at the top right of the page, enter your email and a password, and confirm the link we email you.

question: I forgot my password. What should I do?
answer: Click 'Forgot password' on the login page, enter your email, and follow the reset link we send you.

question: Can I cancel my order?
variants: I changed my mind about my purchase
answer: You can cancel within 12 hours of placing the order from 'My Orders'. After that, the order may already be packed, so contact support.

question: How can I contact customer support?
answer: Email support@LittleAura.com or use the live chat. We reply within 24 hours, Monday to Saturday.

question: Do you offer discounts or coupon codes?
variants: how to get a cheaper price
answer: Yes. Subscribe to our newsletter for a 10% welcome coupon and for seasonal sale announcements.

question: What if I receive a damaged or wrong item?
variants: an item is missing from my order
answer: We're sorry about that. Send a photo to support@littleaura.com within 7 days and we'll send a replacement, send the missing item, or refund you.

question: How can I give feedback or leave a review?
variants: I am happy with my purchase
I want to share my opinion
answer: Thank you! You can rate and review any product from 'My Orders' by clicking 'Write a review'. For other feedback or complaints, email    support@LittleAura.com.

question: Do your products have a warranty?
variants: do you give any guarantee on products
answer: Electronics come with a 1-year manufacturer warranty. Other items are covered by our 30-day return policy.

question: Hello
answer: Hello! 👋 I'm the shop's FAQ assistant. Ask me about orders, delivery, returns, payments, and more.

question: Thank you
answer: You're welcome! Let me know if you have any other questions.

question: What products do you sell?
answer: Little Aura sells clothing, accessories, and gift items. Browse the categories at the top of the page to see everything we have.

question: How can I place an order?
answer: Add items to your cart, click 'Checkout', enter your delivery address and payment details, and confirm. You'll get a confirmation email right away.

question: Do you offer home delivery?
variants: can you deliver to my house
do you deliver to my door
will it be delivered to my address
answer: Yes, we deliver to your door. Enter your address at checkout, and standard delivery takes 3-5 business days.

question: Are your products original and good quality?
variants: is it a good quality product
answer: Yes. Every product is checked for quality before it ships, and if something isn't right, you can return it within 30 days.

question: Do I need an account to shop?
variants: can I buy without signing up
answer: No, you can check out as a guest. Creating an account is optional, but it lets you track orders and save your address for next time.

question: Are all products in stock?
variants: when will it be back in stock
will you notify me when it is available again
notify me when it is back in stock
answer: Stock levels are shown on each product page. If an item is sold out, tap 'Notify me' and we'll email you when it's back.

question: How can I see product details and specifications?
variants: where can I find the product description
answer: Open any product page and scroll to the 'Details' section. It lists the material, sizes, colors, and care instructions.

question: Do you offer Cash on Delivery (COD)?
variants: can I pay when the order arrives
answer: Yes, Cash on Delivery is available in most areas. Choose 'Cash on Delivery' at checkout and pay the courier when your order arrives.

question: Is there a minimum order amount?
variants: what is the smallest order I can place
do I have to spend a certain amount
answer: There's no minimum order amount. You can order a single item.

question: Do you deliver all over Bangladesh?
variants: is delivery available in my district
answer: Yes, we deliver to all 64 districts of Bangladesh. Delivery takes 1-3 days inside Dhaka and 3-5 days elsewhere.

question: Can I change my delivery address after placing an order?
variants: send it to a different address
answer: You can change the address within 12 hours of ordering from 'My Orders'. After that, please contact support and we'll try to update it before dispatch.

question: Can I exchange a product for a different size or color?
variants: it does not fit, can I get a different one
change the color of my item
answer: Yes. Within 30 days of delivery you can exchange an unused item for a different size or color from 'My Orders' by clicking 'Exchange'.

question: Is my personal information safe?
variants: how do you use my details
answer: Yes. We only use your details to process orders, and we never sell or share them with third parties.

question: Can I place an order through Facebook or WhatsApp?
variants: can I order on social media
answer: Yes. Message us on our Facebook page or WhatsApp with the product name, size, and your delivery address, and our team will confirm your order.

question: Can I order multiple products in one purchase?
variants: buy more than one item at once
add several items to my cart
answer: Yes. Add as many items as you like to your cart and check out once. They ship together when all items are in stock.

question: Can I request a product that is not listed on your website?
variants: I can't find the item I want
can you get a product for me
answer: We'd love to help. Send the product details to support@littleaura.com and we'll let you know whether we can source it.

question: Do product prices include VAT or other taxes?
answer: All prices shown include VAT. The only extra cost at checkout is the delivery charge, if it applies.

question: How do I use a promo code?
variants: where do I enter a discount code
can I use two promo codes
can I use multiple discount codes on one order
my promo code is not working
how can I apply a promo code at checkout
how to use a coupon code
where do I put my promo code
answer: Enter your code in the 'Promo code' box at checkout and click 'Apply'. Only one code can be used per order, and it can't be combined with other offers.

question: Why is my payment showing as pending?
answer: Payments can stay pending for up to 30 minutes while the bank or mobile wallet confirms them. If it's still pending after an hour, contact support with your order number.

question: What if my payment was deducted but my order was not confirmed?
variants: money was taken but I got no confirmation
I was charged but the order failed
answer: Please don't pay again. Email support@littleaura.com with your payment receipt. We'll confirm your order or refund the amount within 5-7 business days.

question: Can I pay in installments?
answer: Installment plans are available on selected cards for orders over 5,000 BDT. You'll see the option at checkout if your card qualifies.

question: Can I schedule my delivery for a specific date?
variants: I want it delivered next week
answer: Yes. Choose 'Schedule delivery' at checkout and pick a date up to 14 days ahead.

question: Do you offer express or same-day delivery?
answer: Express delivery takes 1-2 business days and costs 90 Taka (free over 1200 Taka). Same-day delivery is available in Dhaka for orders placed before 12 PM.

question: Can someone else receive my order for me?
variants: can a family member accept my package
can my friend collect the parcel
someone else will be at home
answer: Yes. Add the receiver's name and phone number at checkout. They'll need to show the order number to the courier.

question: What happens if the courier cannot reach me?
variants: I was not available when it arrived
answer: The courier will try again the next day, up to 3 attempts. After that the parcel returns to us, and you can contact support to arrange a new delivery.

question: Can I inspect the product before accepting delivery?
variants: can I open the parcel first
look at the product when it arrives
answer: You can check that the package is sealed and undamaged in front of the courier. If anything looks wrong, refuse it and contact support right away.

question: Can I return a product without its original packaging?
answer: Returns are easiest with the original packaging and tags. If you no longer have them, contact support. We'll decide based on the condition of the item.

question: Are sale or discounted products eligible for returns and exchanges?
variants: can I return a sale item
can I exchange a discounted product
exchange something bought during a sale
answer: Yes. Sale items can be returned or exchanged within 30 days, like any other item. Refunds are for the amount you actually paid.

question: Do you provide digital invoices or receipts?
answer: Yes. A digital invoice is emailed when your order ships, and you can download it anytime from 'My Orders'.

question: Can I buy a gift, and do you offer gift wrapping?
variants: purchase a gift for someone else
send a present to a friend
answer: Yes. Tick 'This is a gift' at checkout to hide the price, add a message card, and choose gift wrapping for a small fee. You can ship it straight to the receiver.

question: Do you offer wholesale pricing for bulk orders?
answer: Yes. For orders of 20 or more items, email support@littleaura.com with your list and we'll send a wholesale quote.

question: How can I stay updated about new arrivals and sales?
answer: Subscribe to our newsletter at the bottom of the page and follow Little Aura on Facebook and Instagram to hear about new arrivals and sales first.

question: How do I get a refund?
variants: how can I return it and get a refund
how do I get my money back
answer: Go to 'My Orders', choose the item, and click 'Return', then print the prepaid label. Once we receive the item, your refund is processed within 5-7 business days. If the item arrived damaged, send a photo to support@littleaura.com within 7 days.
